page_title: STU 1-0 FRE | Stuttgart v Freiburg 01/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Florian Badstubner has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Julian Schuster is stunned as referee Florian Badstubner shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
90+5' Referee Florian Badstubner halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Sebastian Hoeness, then shows him a yellow.
90+5' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
90+3' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Florian Badstubner lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
90+3' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Deniz Undav walks off the pitch to be replaced by Luca Jaquez (VfB Stuttgart).
90+2' Bruno Ogbus (Freiburg) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Alexander Nubel pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' 1 - 0 An excellent first touch by Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart), who collects a splendid pass and from the edge of the box slams the ball into the top right corner!
89' So close! Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post.
88' Total attempts – 16:10.
86' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
84' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) is first to the lofted pass but plants a header miles over the bar from close in.
82' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Stuttgart.

81' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Stuttgart.
80' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
78' Julian Schuster is forced to make a change. Philipp Treu (Freiburg) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Bruno Ogbus.
77' That's the end of the game for Atakan Karazor, who is replaced by Chema Andres (VfB Stuttgart).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Bilal El Khannouss leaves the pitch and Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) comes on.
76' Here is a change. Yuito Suzuki is going off and Julian Schuster gives the last tactical orders to Lucas Holer (Freiburg).
76' Substitution. Derry Scherhant makes way for Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg).
74' The resulting set piece from Stuttgart is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
72' The goalkeeper dives to deny Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post.
70' Some great controlled play and passing from Stuttgart. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
68' Julian Schuster has decided to make a change. Cyriaque Irie (Freiburg) replaces Jan-Niklas Beste.
68' Here's the change. Johan Manzambi leaves the pitch and Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) comes on as a substitute.
67' 4:2 – the corner kicks stats.
64' Stuttgart players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
62' Stuttgart have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
61' A pass from Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) is intercepted by Alexander Nubel and the move breaks down.
59' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to substitute Nikolas Nartey and he is replaced by Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart).
59' Substitution. Ramon Hendriks makes his way off the pitch and Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) comes on as his replacement.
59' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) commits a foul and Florian Badstubner immediately signals a free kick.
57' Freiburg have a corner.
55' 69:31 – the ratio of ball possession.
53' The game has begun to heat up. Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
52' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) was quite harsh and Florian Badstubner didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
50' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
50' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.
48' A nice individual effort by Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
44' Freiburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
43' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the left post.
42' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Stuttgart comes to nothing.

41' Nikolas Nartey (VfB Stuttgart) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads towards the top of the net, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Stuttgart.
41' Stuttgart keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
39' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) puts a poor free kick into the box that Alexander Nubel easily collects.
37' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to score from a difficult angle on the edge of the box, but sends his effort narrowly wide of the left post.
35' The linesman raises his flag. Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) is adjudged offside.
34' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Noah Atubolu makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
33' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 6:2.
31' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the left post.
30' Poor challenge! Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) is penalised for tripping and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle.
29' What a great touch by Nikolas Nartey (VfB Stuttgart) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
27' A cross into the box from Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) is cleared.
25' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
24' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
22' Some patient build-up play from Stuttgart as they look to unlock the defence.
20' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
19' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
18' Surely that's handball by one of the Freiburg players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
17' The percentage of ball possession is – 69:31.
15' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
13' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
11' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
9' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
7' The ball is cleared after Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
6' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) makes a rough challenge and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar.
3' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) makes a strong challenge and Florian Badstubner blows for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Freiburg will kick the game off.
Florian Badstubner is introduced as the referee for today's match.
